rVenue.name: Nasdaq Options
rVenue.materialAspects:
"NASDAQ Options Market (“NOM”) provides tiered pricing. Instinet pays fees and receives rebates based upon NOM’s pricing schedule. The pricing schedule provided by NOM, including the pricing for each tier, is available to the public
https://listingcenter.nasdaq.com/rulebook/nasdaq/rules/nasdaq-options-7
During July 2025, the payment rate is 1.00 per contract or less, for orders routed to the destination, which were 606A1 eligible. Instinet, LLC does not maintain a profit-sharing relationship with the destination, it does not receive incentives/disincentives for equaling or exceeding/failing to meet agreed upon order flow volume thresholds, and it does not maintain an agreement regarding the minimum amount of order flow that it would send to a destination. Instinet's tiers related to routing non-directed orders from institutional customers are available at
https://www.instinet.com/legal-regulatory/ILLC_Rule-606A1_Supplement_Q3-2025.CSV."
